configurations.name: mobile-web
runtimeArgs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_API_URL=http://localhost:8010 EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_API_TOKEN="$APP_TOKEN" npx expo start --web

configurations.name: backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env uvicorn lsf.app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8010
